title: Kaiserkram
description:
Foundry v14. A box of opt-in tools by X4mb: World Landing (pick a scene that opens when the world starts), Deploy Party (drop an actor folder as one party marker and deploy it), Within Earshot (proximity voice chat) and, in Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e worlds, the Trader shop sheet.

Everything is off until you enable it under Configure Settings → Kaiserkram → Kaiserkram Features. A disabled feature registers nothing.

Install: Setup → Add-on Modules → Install Module → https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X4mb/kaiserkram/main/module.json
